phase: Independent workflow validation; exploratory extension after diagnostic suite
selection: All 50 email-domain tasks whose reference outcome contains send_email or forward_email; archived GPT-4.1 all-tools run, 2026-06-04. Keep all eligible tasks and errors. Select before inspecting sanitization outcomes.
execution: Replay archived structured tool arguments in the published sandbox functions; no eval of archived code strings. Verify recipient and final outbox state against reference recipient sets.
counterfactual: For each replay with an actual outbound operation, change only first outbound recipient to a fixed unused synthetic address and reexecute the entire fixed action sequence. Retain original user request, read actions, and generated assistant text. Label this a controlled perturbation of an archived agent workflow, not an observed prompt-injection attack or autonomous rollout.
native_logging: Serialize all replayed calls and tool results through Grafana and LangSmith native export paths. Capture full logs; do not discard additional evidence to force collision.
privacy_checks: Equality and domain relations intentionally disclosed
Previously unseen recipient with no prior equality witness
llm_extension: After source/replay audit, use one hosted model with a fixed prompt on a stratified subset of original/masked/aliased views; preserve neutral abstention option, no prompt tuning on selected items. Budget at most $3 total in existing shared ledger.
limitations: Benchmark is synthetic workplace data, not production users
Counterfactuals are intervention evidence; not estimates of natural attack prevalence
Receiver authorization alone is narrower than whole-task correctness
